pages.quiz:
ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Energy resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy resources.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping home.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Managing waste environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. C — Producers

10. B — 100 °C
